occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: Help Scout is a help desk software that consolidates customer communications from email, SMS, social, chat, and voice into a single inbox to help teams resolve conversations faster [D:Help Scout:landing:1, D:Help Scout:landing:2].

tasks.text: Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services, take or enter orders, cancel accounts, or obtain details of complaints.
Complete contract forms, prepare change of address records, or issue service discontinuance orders, using computers.
Keep records of customer interactions or transactions, recording details of inquiries, complaints, or comments, as well as actions taken.
Check to ensure that appropriate changes were made to resolve customers' problems.

occupations.title: Computer User Support Specialists
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: As a help desk software used by SaaS companies, computer user support specialists would use Help Scout to manage and resolve technical support conversations with users [D:Help Scout:landing:1, D:Help Scout:landing:7].

tasks.text: Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
Set up equipment for employee use, performing or ensuring proper installation of cables, operating systems, or appropriate software.
Read technical manuals, confer with users, or conduct computer diagnostics to investigate and resolve problems or to provide technical assistance and support.
Confer with staff, users, and management to establish requirements for new systems or modifications.

occupations.title: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: These supervisors would use Help Scout's productivity reports to manage staffing and scheduling challenges for the customer service teams they oversee [D:Help Scout:landing:6].

tasks.text: Implement corporate or departmental policies, procedures, and service standards in conjunction with management.
Make recommendations to management concerning such issues as staffing decisions or procedural changes.
Resolve customer complaints or answer customers' questions regarding policies and procedures.
Supervise the work of office, administrative, or customer service employees to ensure adherence to quality standards, deadlines, and proper procedures, correcting errors or problems.
